description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, the Twins Realty team interviews Jonah, a 22-year-old café shop owner, about entrepreneurship and taking risks at a young age.

His advice is simple: when you're young, take the opportunities in front of you. It may feel scary, but trying new things early in life can open doors you never expected.

Stories like this highlight the entrepreneur spirit in Central Texas and the local businesses shaping the community.
